_comment: Key names of the Secrets Manager JSON secret (FV_SECRET_ID). Never put real values in this file. scripts/init-secrets.sh generates the required keys; optional keys are added by hand later. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
OPENAI_API_KEY: <optional: enables the real OpenAI provider; requires FV_OPENAI_MODEL>
FV_OPENAI_MODEL: <optional: exact OpenAI model id your account may use>
